tei:div.tei:p: smon lam dpag bsam rgyas pa yid bzhin dpal ster bzhugs: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma rtsa gsum lha: gnas yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can dang: rigs brgya'i khyab bdag bla ma de mkhyen no: bdag gi smon lam 'grub pa'i dbang po mdzod: deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar: mchog gsum bla ma rnams dang mi 'bral zhing: thugs rgyud dgongs pa'i ye shes yon tan kun: bdag gi rgyud la 'pho zhing smin grol shog: tshul khrims gsum gyis byang chub lam la gnas: shes rab gsum gyis bslab pa'i gzhi bzung nas: theg gsum yang dag 'bras bu mthar phyin te: byang chub sems dpa'i dgongs spyod bgyi nus shog: skye zhing skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du: dpal ldan bla ma'i phrin las dpal gyur te: gu ru yab yum thugs bzhed 'grub pa dang: zab gter chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin nus shog: sgrub la brtson zhing dam chos 'phel ba dang: sdom dang bslab pa dam tshig la gnas shing: dag snang mos gus phyogs med 'char ba yis: snang srid dag mnyam chos skur rtogs 518)par shog: bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin grub 'bras mngon gyur nas: lta sgom spyod 'bras gnas lugs gding thob ste: nyin mtshan 'od gsal ngang las mi 'da' bar: gzhon nu bum sku'i gtan srid zin par shog: mdor na bdag gis byang chub bsgrub pa la: smon log bdud kyis mi mthun bsam sbyor las: phyi nang rgyu rkyen bar chad 'tshe ba kun: rtsa gsum srung ma'i mthu yis zhi ba dang: 'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun rkyen legs 'grub nas: rang gzhan don gnyis 'bad med lhun grub shog: rim gnyis zab mo'i lam la brtson pa dang: lus dang longs spyod dngos po ci mchis pa: ma lus 'gro ba'i don du 'gyur ba dang: bsdu dngos bzhi yis 'khor ba stongs nus shog: bdag nyid mthong dang dran nam reg pa dang: tha na rlung rdzi phog pa tsam gyis kyang:

nyon mongs kun zhi sgo gsum sgrib dag nas: nges 'byung byang sems rgyud la skye bar shog: bdag dang bdag gi 'brel thogs sems can kun: tshe 'di'i lus brjes snang ba 'gyur ma thag: rnam dag zhing khams dpal ri'i pho brang du: rig 'dzin pad 'byung ston 'khor dbyer med drung: 'khor gyi 519)thog mar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog: slar yang gdul bya'i mos ngor gang 'dul gyi: sprul pa mang po bye ba phrag brgya yis: khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs bar: 'gro don rlabs chen gegs med 'byung nus shog: bdag gi smon lam 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge: mtha' yas 'gro ba sems can don du bsngo: ma lus phyam gcig sangs rgyas pa thob nas: rgyal bstan nyams med rgyas pa'i rgyur 'gyur shogaḥ dkon mchog rtsa gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs dang: bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i rten 'brel mthus: bsam pa'i don la bar chad mi 'byung zhing: smon bzhin gegs med yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig: ces smon tshig nyung bsdus 'di yang rang slob dam pa rtog bral nam ba'i rnal 'byor shes rab 'od zer lha ldan la byon skabs 'di ltar dgos zhes lha reg dri bral dang reg bya bzang gos dbang mdog gi skyes bcas bka' bskul zab phyir ma ldog tsam du kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// dge'o// 520)
